# SpanishDictionary.com

> > Comprehensive Spanish-English translation platform with dictionary, conjugation tools, pronunciation guides, and grammar lessons for learners at all levels.

SpanishDictionary.com (SpanishDict) offers over 1 million words and phrases for translation, covering regional variations from Spain, Latin America, Argentina, Peru, Bolivia, Costa Rica, and Colombia. The platform provides detailed verb conjugations, pronunciation training with videos, and extensive grammar guides with etymology and cultural context.

## Key Topics

- Spanish-English translation
- Verb conjugations and tenses
- Spanish grammar guides
- Pronunciation training
- Regional variations (Spain, Latin America, Argentina, Peru, Bolivia, Costa Rica, Colombia)
- Vocabulary lessons
- Beginner Spanish resources
- Etymology and word origins
- Days of the week
- Capitalization rules
- Syllable stress
- Auxiliary verbs (haber)
- Irregular verbs (hacer)
- Language education tools

## Core Translation Tools

- [SpanishDictionary.com | English to Spanish Translation, Dictionary, Translator](https://www.spanishdict.com/): Homepage for Spanish-English translation with 1M+ words and phrases
- [Spanish Pronunciation | SpanishDictionary.com](https://www.spanishdict.com/pronunciation): Spanish alphabet and pronunciation guide with videos and syllable stress

## Verb Conjugation Reference

- [Hacer Conjugation | Conjugate Hacer in Spanish](https://www.spanishdict.com/conjugate/hacer): Complete conjugation reference for irregular verb 'hacer' in all tenses
- [Haber Conjugation | Conjugate Haber in Spanish](https://www.spanishdict.com/conjugate/haber): Complete conjugation reference for auxiliary verb 'haber' in all tenses

## Grammar Guides & Vocabulary Lessons

- [Spanish Days of the Week | SpanishDictionary.com](https://www.spanishdict.com/guide/days-of-the-week-in-spanish): Guide teaching days of the week in Spanish with etymology and grammar
